# Railway

> > Railway is a cloud platform for deploying and hosting applications with one-click templates, supporting PostgreSQL, Redis, AI assistants, WebSocket servers, and containerized workloads.

Railway provides infrastructure-as-a-service with usage-based pricing and instant deployment templates. The platform specializes in AI integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter), database hosting (PostgreSQL, Redis, TimescaleDB), and real-time communication services, with strong support for Docker, Node.js, Rust, and TypeScript applications.

## Key Topics

- Railway deployment platform
- One-click deploy templates
- PostgreSQL and TimescaleDB hosting
- AI assistant deployment (OpenClaw, SimplestClaw)
- OpenAI and Anthropic integration
- WebSocket and real-time servers
- Docker containerization
- OpenRouter AI gateway
- Self-hosting solutions
- Database replication and high availability
- Telegram and WhatsApp bot hosting
- Rust and Node.js applications
- Persistent storage management
- Cloud infrastructure automation

## Platform Overview

- [Pricing](https://railway.com/pricing): Railway usage-based pricing with subscription tiers and resource limits

## AI Assistants and Automation

- [Deploy OpenClaw](https://railway.com/deploy/openclaw): Deploy OpenClaw: AI assistant with WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord integration
- [Deploy OpenClaw (Production)](https://railway.com/deploy/openclaw-2): Deploy OpenClaw: Production-ready AI automation engine with Telegram support
- [Deploy simplestclaw (openai)](https://railway.com/deploy/simplestclaw-openai): Deploy SimplestClaw: One-click OpenClaw AI assistant with OpenAI
- [Deploy simplestclaw (openrouter)](https://railway.com/deploy/simplestclaw-openrouter): Deploy SimplestClaw: One-click OpenClaw with OpenRouter AI gateway
- [Deploy NanoClaw (OpenClaw Lightweight Alternative)](https://railway.com/deploy/nanoclaw): Deploy NanoClaw: Lightweight Claude Agent SDK with multi-channel messaging
- [Deploy Moltis](https://railway.com/deploy/moltis): Deploy Moltis: Personal AI gateway in Rust with multi-provider support
- [Deploy n8n-MCP](https://railway.com/deploy/n8n-mcp-2): Deploy n8n-MCP: Model Context Protocol server with Claude Desktop integration
- [Deploy Open Lovable](https://railway.com/deploy/open-lovable): Deploy Open Lovable: AI website builder with React cloning via ComputeSDK

## Database Hosting

- [Deploy PostgreSQL 18 HA Cluster (AI & GIS Ready)](https://railway.com/deploy/postgresql-18-ha-cluster-ai-and-gis-read): Deploy PostgreSQL 18 HA cluster with pgvector, PostGIS, and Pgpool-II
- [Deploy TimescaleDB HA (Primary + Replica)](https://railway.com/deploy/timescaledb-replica-postgresql): Deploy TimescaleDB HA: Primary-replica time-series DB with Pgpool balancer

## Real-Time Communication

- [Deploy Sockudo](https://railway.com/deploy/sockudo): Deploy Sockudo: Pusher-compatible realtime WebSocket server in Rust
- [Deploy FastAPI WebSocket Chat](https://railway.com/deploy/fastapi-websocket-chat): Deploy FastAPI WebSocket Chat: Real-time multi-user chat with Python/Uvicorn
